fact: At the 14th RCMRD Conference of Ministers in Swakopmund, Minister Inge Zaamwani said the ministry had deployed the ERDAS APOLLO platform through the Office of the Surveyor-General as a central repository for satellite imagery to support monitoring of crop health and pastures, and that Namibia uses Digital Earth Africa, AfriGEO and GMES & Africa for early warning.
title: Namibia calls for greater use of geospatial technology
